$comment: Recrops for v1 images that are usable once the AI frame artefacts (film borders, burnt-in text, sleeve labels) are cut away. Box = fractions of the source: x, y = top-left, f = side fraction (the crop keeps the source ratio). Apply with: node brand/photography/tools/recrops.mjs --apply (writes <name>-v2.jpg next to the v1 file; v1 stays).
